Wow. I had not heard a word about Nader in years. I honestly didn’t know he was still with us.  But he emerges from the wilderness to rain hot fire over intrusive regulations about … hummus at airports. 

Would that he had been a fraction as outraged about vast numbers of regulations that held back American prosperity and medical innovation.
